author: Cleo Abram
description:
This new map shows dark energy might be getting weaker. That’s odd.

Every dot you see here is either a galaxy or a special kind of black hole, and there are 47 million in this new 3D map of our universe.

It’s uprooting what we thought we knew about dark energy and implying our universe might be headed toward a very different ending than we thought…

For more on that, subscribe!

title: Dark Energy Is Getting Weaker?
